targets.query: from(bucket: "telemetry") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "cpu") |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "usage_user") |> filter(fn: (r) => r["cpu"] == "cpu-total") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false) |> yield(name: "last")
